_comment: jinn-repo.v1 live-issue Task template — the prospective branch of the
retrospective merged-pr branch (which carries merged_pr / test_files /
test_cmd gold), a live issue has no fix yet, so it carries issue_number
instead and an optional effort tier (the board's Effort field). See
§"No new SolverType: a live variant of jinn-repo".
base_commit pins origin/next at task-post time; problem_statement is a
frozen snapshot of the issue body — material issue edits cancel and
re-post the task rather than mutating it in place.
problem_statement:
jinn-repo live-issue spec variant (schema + SDK payloads + registry)

jinn-repo.v1 is retrospective-only: its schema requires merged_pr, test_files (FAIL_TO_PASS gold), and test_cmd -- fields a live issue cannot have, because the fix doesn't exist yet. Live-issue tasks need a schema variant: a discriminated union (source: 'merged-pr' | 'live-issue') where the live branch replaces the oracle fields with issue_number, an issue-body snapshot reference, and effort.
